caption:
26 days until the August SAT — and regular registration closes Aug 7.

After that it's the late window (extra fee) until Aug 11, and test centers near you may already be full. Thirty seconds today: register, pick your center, download Bluebook.

Send this to a friend who hasn't registered yet.

Seva tells you WHY you missed it: content gap, trap answer, or rushing. Start for free today — link in bio.

#SAT #SATprep #augustSAT #digitalSAT #satregistration #sattips #studytok #testprep

slides.title: Not registered yet? ^^Aug 7^^ is the line
slides.hand: send this to a friend who forgot

slides.title: The late window is not a safety net
slides.body: Test centers assign seats first-come. Wait past Aug 7 and you're paying an extra fee for whatever centers are *left* — and near you, that may be none. The students who register on time take the close seats.
slides.tip: Register first, build the study plan second

slides.title: Thirty seconds and you're done
slides.body: Register at satsuite.collegeboard.org and pick the closest center while seats exist. Then download Bluebook and run the device check the week before — because a test-day tech problem is the one miss you can't review.
slides.tip: Registered? Send this to a friend who isn't

slides.title: Seva doesn't just grade you. It tells you *why* you fell for the trap.
slides.body: Every miss diagnosed: content gap, trap answer, or rushing.
